entry.title: DeepZero Says IPO Success Signals Strong Belief in AI
entry.summary: Beijing DeepZero Chairwoman Grace Huang says the market’s reaction to the its Hong Kong IPO is a sign that people are recognizing the power of AI. DeepZero's shares surged more than 260% on its debut on May 27. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Africa Startups Turn Inward as US AI Boom Drains Venture Capital
entry.summary: African startups are rewriting their funding playbook as the global artificial intelligence boom pulls venture capital toward the US, forcing emerging markets to compete for cash.

entry.title: Memory Chip Giant CXMT Heads for China’s Biggest IPO Since 2022
entry.summary: Memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies Inc. has received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange for an initial public offering that’s on track to be the biggest in mainland China since 2022, in a milestone for one of the key technologies of the artificial intelligence buildout.

entry.title: SpaceX Investor Powerlaw to Debut on Nasdaq as IPO Race Heats Up
entry.summary: Powerlaw Corp., a closed-end fund that owns stakes in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and artificial intelligence firm OpenAI, is going public without raising any capital in the latest public vehicle to cater to retail investors’ clamor for exposure to the hottest private tech companies.

entry.title: Plenty of Ways to Play AI Trade in Europe, Goldman Sachs Says
entry.summary: Sharon Bell, equity strategist at Goldman Sachs, discusses the artificial intelligence trade and why she thinks European stocks, and not just tech firms, can benefit. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Airbnb-backed WeRoad raises $58M to take its group travel platform to the US
entry.summary: WeRoad, the Milan-based group travel startup, has raised a $58 million Series C round led by Airbnb as it prepares for its first major expansion outside Europe. The funding brings the company’s total capital raised to roughly $100 million and will finance WeRoad’s push into the U.S., beginning with Austin. The new investment reflects a […]

entry.title: Bridging Africa’s Innovation Gap: From Potential To Power
entry.summary: While Africa’s innovation ecosystem is growing rapidly, it still faces major challenges, writes Mind the Bridge's Alberto Onetti, who argues that the continent's weak electrical grid infrastructure and limited domestic venture capital will need large-scale public and private investment to unlock its economic and technological potential.

entry.title: Fireworks AI in Talks for Funding at $15 Billion Valuation
entry.summary: Fireworks AI, a startup that helps companies run artificial intelligence models, is in talks to raise a new round of funding that would value the company at $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: Starship’s path to reusability looks murky after SpaceX’s S-1
entry.summary: SpaceX's recent IPO and Starship rocket test flight delivered two big data points that offer a realistic vision for the coming years — and one that may disappoint both the company's boosters and its critics.

entry.title: Zepto Said to Plan June Public Filing for $1 Billion India IPO
entry.summary: Rapid-commerce firm Zepto Ltd. is preparing to publicly file in the first half of June for an initial public offering that may raise up to $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: SoftBank Shares Hit Record With Lift From OpenAI IPO Hopes
entry.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. shares climbed to a record high, spurred by hopes of big returns from the Japanese investor’s stakes in OpenAI and SB Energy Corp., should the two go public.

entry.title: How New Mega-Cap IPOs Will Reshape the Markets
entry.summary: SpaceX is marketing itself to IPO investors as an artificial intelligence targeting a $26.5 trillion potential market opportunity. The move signaling its intention to wrest business from investor darlings whose valuations have soared. Bloomberg Market Structure Research Head Larry Tabb joined David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Hyperscaler Debt Flood Brings Derivatives Bonanza
entry.summary: As big tech companies raise hundreds of billions of dollars to fund artificial intelligence investments, Wall Street banks are increasingly finding they have to trade more credit derivatives to keep doing business with the hyperscalers.

entry.title: Governance Concerns Over SpaceX IPO & the Upside of Financing AI
entry.summary: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine discusses the governance concerns over the SpaceX IPO. He talks about the potential legislative changes that could be made to curb these mega-IPOs. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: AI’s Expanding Market Grip Traps Active Managers on Wall Street
entry.summary: The AI boom is humbling the humans trying to navigate the markets it increasingly distorts.
